title: austroeupatorium candidum
intro: Austroeupatorium candidum, commonly known as the "white boneset", is a plant species native to the Andes mountains in South America. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The plant is known for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which can help relieve congestion and open airways. The bioactive constituents of Austroeupatorium candidum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
